channel.title: Optics blog
channel.description: Articles, videos and posts about Optics, the open-source test automation framework.

item.title: Your tests passed. Your app didn't.
item.description: Error definitions catch crash dialogs, "Session expired" and other error screens that no step checked for. List the messages in one CSV file, and Optics looks for them on the last screen of every run.

item.title: Introducing Optics: create a test your way, run it forever
item.description: Optics is an open-source test automation framework for Android, iOS, web and TV apps. Tests are CSV or YAML files, and each element on screen can have several locators.
